red_baseline.assertion: Every follow-up Messages request equals the original Runtime prompt followed by all prior assistant block lists and exactly one matching ordered tool_result block per provider call ID.
red_baseline.failure_reason: On the third wire request the v1 continuation replayed only assistant round 2 and its result; assistant round 1 and toolu-read-1's result were absent. The assertion failed before the fourth request because context loss was already proven.

ordered_contents: original Runtime prompt as the first user message
every complete assistant content block list, including thinking, redacted and unknown JSON-safe blocks
one immediately following user tool_result block list ordered by the matching provider tool_use IDs
continuation.request_path_behavior: The adapter combines the exact wire messages with the newly parsed assistant blocks after each transport response, then replays the accumulated transcript on the next stateless request.

validation.tool_results: exact ordered one-to-one closure for the immediately preceding assistant tool_use batch
validation.legacy_v1: fails closed before transport because it cannot reconstruct prior rounds
validation.parser_only_fragment: parse_response retains a JSON-safe assistant_content fragment internally; production request upgrades it to a complete transcript and rejects persisted fragments before transport
